title: Keep accepted interview correction fail-closed on broken change records
description: Keep accepted interview correction fail-closed on broken change records
acceptance_criteria: When an unrelated change has corrupt committed workflow history, correcting accepted interview metadata must fail with that history error before writing any new evidence. The same correction must succeed with a valid project roster, and the healthy change’s read-only status must remain independent from that sibling.

answers.constraints: Keep accepted corrections append-only (REQ-change-032). Isolate unrelated history failures only in read-only status and handoff.
